package appliance

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	facts "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/facts/v1alpha1"
	management "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/management/v1alpha1"
	memory "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/v1alpha1"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestGenerateReleasedGovernanceProcessingFixture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("RELEASE_FIXTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture output")
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 21, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dir := t.TempDir()
	s, auth := newGoldenStoreWithOptions(t, Options{DataDir: dir, Clock: func() time.Time { return now }, Random: rand.New(rand.NewSource(602))})
	defer s.Close()
	putAndBindSteward(t, s, 1)
	type cancelled struct {
		Action    string                      `json:"action"`
		Request   facts.SubmitEvidenceRequest `json:"request"`
		ReceiptID memory.ReceiptID            `json:"receipt_id"`
	}
	var cancelledReceipts []cancelled
	for _, action := range []string{"delete", "correct"} {
		baseReq := factRequest("base-"+action, "coffee is preferred", nil)
		baseReq.Mutations[0].Key = action
		baseReq.Source.FactKey = action
		base := submitFact(t, s, auth, baseReq)
		req := factRequest("dependent-"+action, "coffee remains preferred", nil)
		req.Source.Role = facts.RoleUserQuote
		req.Source.FactKey = action
		req.Mutations = nil
		dependent, err := s.SubmitEvidence(t.Context(), auth, req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		work, found, err := s.ClaimStewardJob(t.Context(), time.Minute)
		if err != nil || !found || len(work.Request.Records) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("claim %v %v", found, err)
		}
		if action == "delete" {
			_, err = s.DeleteReceipt(t.Context(), management.DeleteReceiptRequest{ReceiptID: base.ReceiptID, Reason: "forget", IdempotencyKey: action})
		} else {
			_, err = s.CorrectReceipt(t.Context(), management.CorrectReceiptRequest{ReceiptID: base.ReceiptID, ReplacementText: "water instead", Reason: "correct", IdempotencyKey: action})
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		status, err := s.GetReceiptStatus(t.Context(), auth, memory.GetReceiptStatusRequest{ReceiptID: dependent.ReceiptID})
		if err != nil || status.State != memory.ProcessingStateProcessing {
			t.Fatalf("not the released bug: %+v %v", status, err)
		}
		replay, err := s.SubmitEvidence(t.Context(), auth, req)
		if err != nil || replay.Organization != facts.OrganizationFailed {
			t.Fatalf("job not failed: %+v %v", replay, err)
		}
		cancelledReceipts = append(cancelledReceipts, cancelled{action, req, dependent.ReceiptID})
		now = now.Add(time.Second)
	}
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hashes := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{DatabaseFilename, ManagementCredentialFile, StewardWorkerCredentialFile} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		target := name
		if name != DatabaseFilename {
			target += ".txt"
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, target), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		hashes[target] = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	}
	manifest := map[string]any{"source_tag": "v0.6.0", "source_commit": "f17b0293597dcdf9fad4fcba9ea19e20d1d91674", "schema_version": 2, "clock": now, "test_only_authorization": auth, "cancelled_receipts": cancelledReceipts, "files_sha256": hashes}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "manifest.json"), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
